verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot supports code review workflows via Copilot code review/Autofix (contextual explanations and fix suggestions for vulnerabilities) and agent mode that proposes edits/validates files before merging, plus a desktop workspace to review changes across agents before merge. However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated 'run checks/CI' or diff-inspection UI beyond general GitHub PR review integration, and no independent hands-on confirmation that this catches problems reliably pre-merge. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of CI/test-check integration, hands-on validation of review accuracy, and independent corroboration of the review/Autofix feature's effectiveness.
